findings.summary: Cleanup gate fallback collapses absent ledger and zero-open ledger into the same presentation.
findings.description: Critical: Task 3.3 tells cleanup-feature to print either the reader lines or `no open choices`, while scenario skill-workflow.11 requires both gates to distinguish `no ledger` from `ledger with nothing open`. The shared reader in F3 also prints nothing for both cases, so the cleanup hook as planned has no specified way to satisfy the scenario.
findings.recommendation: Update task 3.3, task 3.7, and likely F3/3.0 so cleanup-feature renders distinct forms for missing `choices.json` and present ledger with zero `needs-user` entries, either by having the reader expose status/entry counts or by requiring the hook to inspect the ledger safely.
findings.resolution: Update task 3.3, task 3.7, and likely F3/3.0 so cleanup-feature renders distinct forms for missing `choices.json` and present ledger with zero `needs-user` entries, either by having the reader expose status/entry counts or by requiring the hook to inspect the ledger safely.

findings.summary: The partial-ledger recovery command does not remove untracked first-run orphans.
findings.description: Critical: F6/task 3.1 say a partial first audit is cleaned up with `git checkout --` for both ledger paths, but `git checkout -- <path>` does not remove an untracked `choices.json` or `choices.md` when no committed pair exists. That leaves the partial artifact in the worktree despite the design claiming the orphan is discarded.
findings.recommendation: Specify separate cleanup for tracked and untracked ledger paths, and add 3.7 coverage for the first-audit partial-pair case so the hook leaves neither path staged or present as an untracked orphan.
findings.resolution: Specify separate cleanup for tracked and untracked ledger paths, and add 3.7 coverage for the first-audit partial-pair case so the hook leaves neither path staged or present as an untracked orphan.

findings.summary: The planned reader call sites do not require installed-skill-relative path resolution.
findings.description: Nit: Tasks 3.2, 3.3, and 3.7 only require the hooks to call `needs_user.py`, and task 3.3 shows a bare `needs_user.py --change-id "$CHANGE_ID"` invocation. Existing skill-workflow requirements require runtime commands and sibling skill references to resolve from `<skill-base-dir>/../...`; a bare command can fail in `.claude/skills` or `.agents/skills` mirrors even if it works from the source tree.
findings.recommendation: Make the hook tasks and content tests require `python3 "<skill-base-dir>/../audit-choices/scripts/needs_user.py" --change-id "$CHANGE_ID" --repo-root ...` or an equivalent installed-skill-relative helper, and reject bare or repo-root `skills/...` paths.
findings.resolution: Make the hook tasks and content tests require `python3 "<skill-base-dir>/../audit-choices/scripts/needs_user.py" --change-id "$CHANGE_ID" --repo-root ...` or an equivalent installed-skill-relative helper, and reject bare or repo-root `skills/...` paths.

findings.summary: Task 3.6 encourages a real change id as a synthetic active fixture path.
findings.description: Nit: Task 3.6 says the tmp fixture repo's active `openspec/changes/<id>/` should hold artifacts for `add-decision-choices-ledger`. The repository's path-stability guard explicitly warns that tmp fixtures should use synthetic ids, while real ids should be resolved with `change_dir()` only when reading source artifacts; a straightforward implementation risks tripping the guard or encoding the exact archival coupling the rule is meant to prevent.
findings.recommendation: Revise 3.6 to use `change_dir(real_repo_root, "add-decision-choices-ledger")` only for reading the archived source artifacts, then copy them into a tmp repo under a synthetic change id such as `fixture-decision-choices-ledger`.
findings.resolution: Revise 3.6 to use `change_dir(real_repo_root, "add-decision-choices-ledger")` only for reading the archived source artifacts, then copy them into a tmp repo under a synthetic change id such as `fixture-decision-choices-ledger`.
